Django News Application
  • API reference
  • news.views

news.views

HTML views and role-based workflows for the news application.

Views handle registration, article submission and review, newsletter management, and reader subscriptions.

Functions

approve_article

Approve an article, email subscribers, and log the approval (POST only).

article_create

Let journalists submit an article for editor approval.

article_delete

Delete an article (POST only).

article_detail

Show one approved article.

article_edit

Edit an article.

home

Show approved articles on the home page.

newsletter_create

Create a newsletter.

newsletter_delete

Delete a newsletter (POST only).

newsletter_edit

Edit a newsletter.

newsletter_list

List newsletters that contain approved articles.

register

Register a user, create an API token, and sign them in.

review_articles

Show submitted articles waiting for editor review.

role_required

Restrict a view to signed-in users with one of the specified roles.

subscriptions

Let a reader view and update their subscriptions.

Details

news.views.role_required(*roles)[source]

Restrict a view to signed-in users with one of the specified roles.

Anonymous users are redirected to the login page. Signed-in users with a different role receive 403 Forbidden.

Parameters:

*roles (str) – Allowed values from news.models.User.Roles.

Returns:

A decorator to apply to a view function.

Return type:

Callable

Example

@role_required(User.Roles.EDITOR)
def review_articles(request):
    ...
news.views.home(request)[source]

Show approved articles on the home page.

URL: /. Available to everyone.

news.views.register(request)[source]

Register a user, create an API token, and sign them in.

URL: /register/. Available to everyone.

news.views.article_detail(request, pk)[source]

Show one approved article.

URL: /articles/<pk>/. Requires sign-in. Unapproved articles return 404 Not Found.

news.views.article_create(request)[source]

Let journalists submit an article for editor approval.

URL: /articles/new/. Journalists only.

news.views.article_edit(request, pk)[source]

Edit an article.

URL: /articles/<pk>/edit/. Editors can edit any article; journalists can edit only their own independent articles. A journalist’s edit sends the article back for approval.

news.views.article_delete(request, pk)[source]

Delete an article (POST only).

URL: /articles/<pk>/delete/. Editors can delete any article; journalists can delete only their own independent articles.

news.views.review_articles(request)[source]

Show submitted articles waiting for editor review.

URL: /editor/review/. Editors only.

news.views.approve_article(request, pk)[source]

Approve an article, email subscribers, and log the approval (POST only).

URL: /editor/articles/<pk>/approve/. Editors only. See news.services.approve_article_and_notify().

news.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]

List newsletters that contain approved articles.

URL: /newsletters/. Requires sign-in.

news.views.newsletter_create(request)[source]

Create a newsletter.

URL: /newsletters/new/. Journalists and editors only.

news.views.newsletter_edit(request, pk)[source]

Edit a newsletter.

URL: /newsletters/<pk>/edit/. Editors can edit any newsletter; journalists can edit only their own.

news.views.newsletter_delete(request, pk)[source]

Delete a newsletter (POST only).

URL: /newsletters/<pk>/delete/. Editors can delete any newsletter; journalists can delete only their own.

news.views.subscriptions(request)[source]

Let a reader view and update their subscriptions.

URL: /subscriptions/. Readers only.
